# nocheck/invariant

> Invariant, turned off: invariant cond checks only the types.

truck [nocheck](../nocheck.md) · [source](../../../registry/nocheck/invariant.pkg)

The same syntax as [check/invariant](../check/invariant.md), but the condition and
messages are never evaluated: the statement compiles to a jump over
them. Use the `nocheck` truck to switch a whole program's checks off.

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`

```
invariant {c: expr bool} [ , {m: expr str} ]*
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `c` | expression | `bool` |
| `m` (optional) | expression | `str` |

## Needs

- [std/if](../std/if.md)
- [std/and](../std/and.md)
- [std/false](../std/false.md)
- [std/let](../std/let.md)

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

```
if false && {c}
{each g in ,}
let {cat $m #g} = {g.m}
{end}
end
```
